21014.ins: The butterfly sits as the focal piece with stone accents set into the wings, and the two colorways split the read completely - black leans gothic, white leans fairy - on the same 40-50 cm adjustable band. Real leather holds the shape through the season.
21014.short: Leather butterfly choker with stone accents in white or black, adjustable 40-50 cm, fairy or gothic read by colorway.

21041.ins: Fluff trim softens the punk framing and the leopard print does the rest, in three temperatures from classic yellow to playful pink. The fit runs 30-40 cm - a full size down from the category standard, and the one spec to check before ordering.
21041.short: Leopard-print punk collar with fluff trim in yellow, gray or pink, smaller 30-40 cm fit, check measurements before ordering.

21070.ins: Heart and star on one collar closes the charm debate without a second purchase, and the three colorways match the widest accessory runs on the site. The band is the category-standard leather construction, adjustable through the full 40-50 cm.
21070.short: Leather collar with heart and star accents in white, black or pink, adjustable 40-50 cm, two-charm styling in one piece.

21071.ins: This is the reference format the rest of the bell-collar category riffs on - collar, chain, bell, matched set - and four colorways is the joint-widest run. The bell rings softly at movement rather than announcing across rooms.
21071.short: Classic big-bell leather collar with matched chain in set red, white, black or pink, adjustable 40-50 cm, soft ring.

21083.ins: The love-wing design - wings flanking a heart - reads Halloween without a single skull or spider, which suits October outfits running dark-sweet rather than full horror. Black leather, one size, adjustable through the standard 40-50 cm range.
21083.short: Black leather Halloween collar with love-wing heart design, adjustable 40-50 cm, dark seasonal accent on year-round leather.

21088.ins: Stone accents catch light the way metal hardware does without the weight, and on pink leather the effect runs sweet with sparkle rather than tough. Single colorway, single style, adjustable band - the simplest decision in the collar drawer.
21088.short: Pink leather puppy collar with light-catching stone accents, adjustable 40-50 cm, sweetest register in the collar category.

21092.ins: Plush trim changes the entire feel against the leather majority - winter-soft at the throat, with pearls dotting the snowflake design per the pictures. White reads ice, black reads evening, and both adjust through the standard 40-50 cm.
21092.short: Plush-trimmed snowflake pearl collar in white or black, leather base, adjustable 40-50 cm, winter-accessory softness.

21093.ins: Printed measurements - collar 32-42 cm, chain 77 cm - settle the fit question at order time, rare in a category of unstated ranges. The cartoon-scale bell is the loudest cute design voice on the site, in pink, white, or black sets.
21093.short: Big-bell leather collar with 77 cm chain in pink, white or black, collar 32-42 cm, printed measurements, set or solo combos.

21114.ins: Matching wear is the entire product: one shade per pair, both bracelets in the bag, elastic enough to forget about through a full day. The price point makes it the add-on item that turns a gift into a themed gift without a second shopping trip.
21114.short: Matching plush bracelet pair for couples in black, pink or red, soft elastic one-size band for all-day wear, both included.

21129.ins: Denim finish stands alone in a collar category of black leather and pastels - the vintage blue wash reads wardrobe rather than costume box. The bell is standard soft-ring, and the fit runs the smaller 30-40 cm band, worth measuring first.
21129.short: Vintage denim-finish bell collar in worn blue, leather base, smaller 30-40 cm fit, the denim option in the collar category.
